using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

public sealed partial class CustomerValidator : IValidatorFor<global::Sample.Customer> {
    public static readonly CustomerValidator Instance = new();

    private CustomerValidator() { }

    private static readonly Regex SkuPattern0 = new Regex("\\A(?:^[A-Z]{3}$)\\z");

    public void Validate(ref ValidationContext ctx, global::Sample.Customer value) {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value.Name)) ctx.AddRequired("name");
        else if (value.Name is not null && (value.Name.Length < 1 || value.Name.Length > 100)) ctx.AddStringLength("name", 1, 100);
        if ((value.Age < 0 || value.Age > 120)) ctx.AddRange("age", 0, 120);
        if (value.Sku is not null && !SkuPattern0.IsMatch(value.Sku)) ctx.AddPattern("sku");
        if (value.Tags is not null && (value.Tags.Count > 5)) ctx.AddItemCount("tags", 0, 5);
    }
